annotations.title: Give feedback on a recalled memory

description: Pass on what the person said about a recalled memory: it helped, is wrong, is stale, or did not fit the query. Kept pending; nothing changes until a person confirms it.

memory_id.description: A memory id from recall or list_recent

note.description: Why, in one line, in the words the person used

query.description: The query the memory was recalled for; required for irrelevant

signal.description: helped: it answered the question. wrong: it is not true. stale: it is out of date. irrelevant: it did not fit the query

name: feedback
title: Give feedback on a recalled memory
